definitions.status: All required capture processes complete with actual exit0; target verdicts separately reported.
definitions.samples: All three observed samples, medians and min/max. Lab medians are not production p75.
definitions.fieldUnavailableReason: No production RUM/CrUX/GSC dataset or 28-day field window available; EventTiming does not replace field INP.
definitions.network: Unique CDP requestId map counts, redirects preserved in raw stream; sum loadingFinished.encodedDataLength is observed encoded transfer including headers where reported, not complete transport bytes. Missing loadingFinished retained.
definitions.phases: Warm priming exists in raw stream; load and subsequent interaction request phases reported separately.
definitions.eventTiming: 16ms observation threshold; after-action values filtered by startTime >= first action.startedAt, not causal attribution or field INP. Original cumulative buffers preserved.
definitions.coverage: Whole-case coverage observations retained. No compressed unused-byte or coverage percentage inferred.
definitions.ttfb: Raw NavigationTiming responseStart-requestStart; requested CDP throttling latency is not a measured physical RTT.
definitions.normalLighthouseDiagnostic: One before Home mobile run excluded from all comparison series.
